greeting: Thanks for calling I Think Services, this is Ava. Are you looking to add an AI receptionist or automate something in your business?

faq.a: We build AI for local businesses — voice agents that answer your phones 24/7, book and manage appointments, and answer customer questions, plus back-office automation and IT and talent services. In short: we help you never miss a call and cut the busywork.
Local and commercial businesses — clinics, salons, home services, retail, restaurants, and more. If your phone rings and you book appointments, we can help.
It's tailored to your setup, and we start with a free demo and audit at no cost. On the call we'll scope it and give you clear numbers — no obligation.
Most businesses are answering real calls within days. We train the agent on your info, connect your lines and calendar, test it, and go live.
You keep your existing number — we route it to the AI, so nothing changes for your customers.
We're based in Charlotte, North Carolina, and we work with businesses across the US.
You can reach the team at contact@ithinkservices.net or 704-387-9775, or I can book you a free demo right now.
